profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Miami-Dade County
profile.summary:
Innovative IT professional with expertise in elevating the performance of diverse organizations through the orchestration of comprehensive information technology solutions. Solid hands-on experience as a developer and manager in a variety of platforms, system architectures and infrastructures.  Exceptional communicator with superior partnering and customer relationship skills.  Expert at building talented teams, mentoring staff, promoting collaboration, and cultivating strong relationships with individuals at all levels.  Results oriented with demonstrated integrity in meeting commitments.  Skilled at anticipating challenges and recognizing opportunities to exceed customer expectations.  Nimble, creative and critical thinker able to imagine possibilities and take a variety of perspectives into account for decision making.  Proven leader with the capacity to translate vision into reality and a track record of converting high-profile, failing projects into successful projects.  

AREAS OF EXPERTISE INCLUDE:
Project Management • Vendor/Consultant Management • Proposals and Presentations • International Projects • Operations Business Process Improvement • Contract Negotiations • Enterprise Rollout Deployments • Technical Writing • Analysis Assessments and Discovery • Alpha Beta Stress Test Plans • Customer Relationship Management CRM • Performance Management/Six Sigma • Asset Management EAMS CMMS Inventory • Call Center 311 • Elections/Voter Systems • Criminal Justice Systems CJIS • Time Reporting • Point of Sale POS • Financial Aid • Airline/Travel Systems • Medical Devices • Statistical Programming • RAD • SLA • BPR • SOP • Bilingual:  English/Spanish

TECHNICAL SUMMARY:
AIX Korn Shell, Assembly (IBM 370, UNIVAC), BASIC/VB, C, Cobol, Fortran, Java/Javascript, Oracle EXPRESS, Pascal, Sabretalk (PL/1), SQL, PL/SQL, XML, .NET, API, ACP, CICS, CMS, Cognos, DOS, IBM QS/1 POS, NCR 2760 POS, OS/2, ROI, RSX-11M, RT-11, SAS, TSO, UNIX, VM, VMS,  Dataflex, IDMS, SQL Server.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Systems Architect, Project Manager, and Technical Lead for enterprise applications at Miami-Dade County. Provided specific technology solutions, support and/or expert internal consulting services for the following Miami-Dade departments: 311 Call Center, Administrative Office of the Courts, Aviation, Clerk of the Courts, Community Action, Consumer Services, Corrections, County Commission, Elections, Emergency Management, Finance, Internal Services, Management and Budget, Parks, Police, Regulatory, Seaport, Sustainability, Transit, Water and Sewer.
•	Managed the Voter Systems unit, which included Oracle, SQL, and web applications. New initiatives included: new Early Voting system, Relia-Vote Absentee Ballot Processing, Document Management with new precinct registers and new Election Night Reporting on the web. Ensured that all of these initiatives were deployed smoothly, with national/local media coverage, judges and County executives present on Election Night.
•	Technical and Project Lead to implement Asset Management (Infor/Oracle/SQL) enterprise schema using mobile technologies/barcode scanners for inventory of capital assets. 
•	Provided support for Asset Management infrastructure and data analysis using PL/SQL.
•	As a member of the Applications Consulting and Technical Services Division, performed technology and business process assessments; provided recommendations and presentations to several County departments and municipalities such as Cities of Miami, Coral Gables and North Miami.
•	Implemented the Performance Management System (Active Strategy/Intranet/SQL Server) ahead of schedule.
•	Was a Project Leader for the Criminal Justice Information System (COBOL); a 24/7 mission critical environment.
•	Incorporated team building activities and focus on staff morale throughout multiple projects and engagements.
•	Management functions included Employee Evaluations, Recruitment, Counseling and Coaching staff, Budgeting/Procurement.

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description: Was the project leader of the Direct Marketing Decision Support System, a combination data mart and operational data store designed to support Campaign Management, Customer Segmentation, Modeling and Scoring.  This system included technology applications in OLAP, OLTP, reporting, data mining, exploratory data analysis and data extraction, transportation, and transformation using SAS and Oracle Express.

positions.title: Program Manager
positions.description: Performed a leadership role in the planning and implementation of information technology for Miami-Dade Community College's Financial Aid college-wide.  Provided guidance and identified opportunities to move Financial Aid towards new technologies.  Analyzed the needs of District Financial Aid in addition to the five Financial Aid offices at the campuses, and applied software/hardware solutions to these needs.

positions.title: Senior Systems Analyst
positions.description: Was a senior analyst to implement restaurant software and data changes at over 900 sites in the U.S., Canada and Mexico.  For a variety of projects, recruited/supervised BKC employees and consultants from Arthur Anderson and Metro.  Led the latest implementations of the IBM and NCR point of sale systems (POS) and back office managers' workstations (MWS).  This included project planning, tracking, vendor negotiations, C programming, Lab, Alpha, Beta testing and nationwide rollouts.  Developed an Executive Information System using EXPRESS (now known as Oracle Express) that provided high level user-driven trend, detail and exception analysis on Burger King restaurants for senior managers using an nth dimensional database.

positions.title: R&D Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Was a software engineer/developer for the DATAFLEX Data Base Engine. DATAFLEX is a multi-user DBMS product that provides a 4GL and set of software development tools. DBE is a multi-tasking, multi-user distributed data base server written in C. Developed the set of low-level routines for multi-tasking, inter-process communications, io buffering, disk performance and other distributed data base functions. Supervised the development of transaction logging, rollback/roll forward, ISAM and other upper-level DBE functions.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: One of the original developers of System One/PC, a travel agency front office and communications package.  Was chosen for this effort because of working knowledge of various environments, including host programming of the SystemOne Reservations System using 370 Assembler for ACP, host programming in Sabretalk (PL/1), applications, communications and systems development in C for PCs and PS/2s.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: As the youngest programmer in the company, concurrent full time employee and full time college student, was in charge of a PDP-11 system in addition to supervision and training of a staff of five (programmers and data entry personnel) in support of statistical analyses of medical device performance.
